title: Moby Dick: launch questions
lede: For the new Moby Dick Specialties website. Answer in your own words, in any order, over as many sittings as you like. Everything you type saves to Nicholas by itself a few seconds after you stop typing: watch for the green Saved line. Nothing to send.

sections.title: Moby Dick Specialties
sections.lead: 12 questions. The research is written under each one.

qs.t: The Moby Dick minimum is $250 (settled: every old-site page says so; the $75 was only the printed '22–'23 book). Counted before or after quantity discounts?
qs.note: Keep a $75 showroom minimum for showroom customers? Yes / no

qs.t: Four items whose base price went up (bases verified on the old site). What is their 12+ price?
qs.w: The site shows a 12+ price BELOW the old one. These items are newer than the printed book, so only you have the number.

qs.t: MA-1051: base $3.65, the site shows 4+ at $3.64 and 8+ at $3.35. Is the 4+ price real, or delete it?
41 Moby Dick items (the MR resin figures) had their quantity tables cleared on 8/19. None are in the printed book.
opts: Put the July tiers back for all 41
Send me the list, I'll mark each line

qs.t: Paying: the old Moby Dick site uses the same words as Upper Deck. Same answers as Upper Deck question 2?
Showroom pickup: the cart asks "How will you get this order?" AND Shopify's checkout has its own Pickup switch. One path only.
Stoneware (8 items) and Butlers (4 items) exist on the old site but every one is out of stock with no ETA. They were taken out of the new menu on 9/4.
opts: Restocking — put them back when stock lands

qs.t: Showroom appointments: both old sites already use the same Calendly page (udlshowroom/showroom-appt). Keep it shared?
The catalog: the old site still offers only the '22–'23 book, and its specials say "GOOD UNTIL December 31, 2023". No newer full catalog was found anywhere.
rows: Keep the '22–'23 book on the new site until the next one is printed?
When is the next Moby Dick catalog due?
The page-5 specials: expired, or still honored?
OK for Nicholas to ask Real3D to swap the public flipbook to the clean no-price edition?

qs.t: Claims: the old Moby Dick claim form has the same rules as Upper Deck's (brass tarnish excluded, glass buoys final sale, 10 days from the ship date, 15% keep-it, next-order credit). Same answer as Upper Deck question 8?
Who runs the Moby Dick web orders
qs.w: Found: orders@mobydickspecialties.com is on every old-site page, fax 508-994-9830. (The old Why Register page still prints the dead 1-800 number and a misspelled email — ignore those.)
rows: Same people as Upper Deck? (SAME, or names)
Who keys Moby Dick web orders into Acctivate / backup

qs.t: 50 items the old site no longer sells but the new site still lists — leave them, or archive?
qs.w: Nicholas said leave them on 9/4. Confirm, or change it.

qs.t: Prices for everyone — same ruling as Upper Deck question 10?
